global: This pork bone tonkotsu ramen features a rich, amber-brown, glossy broth with floating noodles and toppings. Served in a white ceramic bowl with red geometric pattern and blue "ARASAKI" text, it rests on a reddish-brown, smooth, glossy tray with textured, rounded corners.

regions.background: The tray is reddish-brown, smooth, and glossy, with a slightly uneven, textured surface and rounded corners.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red geometric pattern and blue "ARASAKI" text on its rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is rich, amber-brown, and glossy, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
